# ITcon - Journal of Information Technology in Construction

> An open-access, peer-reviewed journal publishing cutting-edge research on digital technologies, BIM, and innovation in architecture, engineering, and construction.

ITcon is a leading academic publication covering construction technology, building information modeling, digital twins, cybersecurity, and emerging innovations in the AEC industry. The journal maintains rigorous peer-review standards while providing free access to all published research under Creative Commons licensing.

## Key Topics

- Building Information Modeling (BIM)
- Digital Twins
- Construction Technology
- AEC Industry
- 3D Concrete Printing
- Virtual Reality & Immersive Technologies
- Cybersecurity in Facilities Management
- Common Data Environment (CDE)
- Regulatory Compliance
- Anthropomorphic Robots
- Open Access Publishing
- Peer Review Process
- Civil Engineering
- Architecture & Engineering
- Information Technology

## Journal Overview & Information

- [ITcon Homepage](https://itcon.org): Homepage for ITcon, an open-access peer-reviewed journal
- [About ITcon](https://itcon.org/about): Information about ITcon journal's mission, history, and organization
- [ITcon Scope](https://itcon.org/scope): Describes ITcon's research scope in construction IT and BIM
- [Editorial Board](https://itcon.org/editorial-board): Lists editorial board members and journal management structure

## For Authors & Submission Guidelines

- [Authors' Guide](https://itcon.org/for-authors): Submission guidelines, formatting instructions, and peer-review process

## Published Articles & Archives

- [All Volumes](https://itcon.org/volumes): Archive of all published journal volumes and articles
- [Volume 31 (2026)](https://itcon.org/volume): Current volume containing articles on BIM, digital twins, and AI
- [Digital Twins in Civil Engineering](https://itcon.org/paper/2026/12): Systematic review of digital twins in civil engineering
- [Digital Twins in Construction Industry](https://itcon.org/paper/2026/7): Systematic review of digital twins practices in construction
- [Multiuser Immersive VR versus BIM Platforms](https://itcon.org/paper/2026/13): Study comparing VR and BIM for remote AEC team collaboration
- [Obstacles and BIM in Architectural Design](https://itcon.org/paper/2026/11): Fuzzy cognitive mapping study of BIM implementation obstacles
- [Information Requirements for BIM in Germany](https://itcon.org/paper/2026/10): Analysis of BIM information requirements in German construction
- [CDE Ecosystem for AECO Sector](https://itcon.org/paper/2026/6): Common Data Environment ecosystem design for architecture and engineering

## Emerging Technologies & Innovation

- [Anthropomorphic Robots in Construction](https://itcon.org/paper/2026/15): Research article on humanoid robots and construction deployment
- [Scaling 3D Concrete Printing Facilities](https://itcon.org/paper/2026/8): Decision-support framework for 3D concrete printing investment
- [Regulatory Compliance via LLM-Powered Frameworks](https://itcon.org/paper/2026/9): AI-powered decision frameworks for AEC regulatory compliance

## Security & Risk Management

- [Pathways to Cyber Peril](https://itcon.org/paper/2026/14): Research on cybersecurity breaches in facilities management

## Research Indexes & Discovery Tools

- [Authors' Index](https://itcon.org/authors): Searchable index of all authors published in ITcon
- [Keywords' Index](https://itcon.org/keywords): Index of research keywords and topics covered in ITcon
